payload.title: FUN-runtime: public-process proof for Factory Runtime after SERVICE+ENGINE DEL
payload.ask: After DEL-RUN-SERVICE and DEL-RUN-ENGINE-PIPELINE Factory completion, prove from an external-user perspective that Factory Runtime still works: process-scoped Runtime construction remains inert until runtime lifecycle, then control/observation/dispatch-plan/JavaScript workflow/orchestration surfaces activate through public Runtime protocol and root contracts composed only via root.BuildProcess and edges.Edges—without inventing root/wire test subsystems or peer-importing factory_runtime/internal or deleted transitional public packages.
systemShapeRequirements: Keep packaged Factory Runtime root as wire/, internal/, transports/ plus thin root contracts; do not fold or delete packages in this packet (residual public testdata/ is inventory debt, not this packet's deletion scope)
Do not invent new pkg/root or pkg/wire Factory Runtime helper APIs solely for tests
Functional proofs construct the process only through root.BuildProcess and replace effects only via edges.Edges
Do not invent Runtime HTTP/CLI/MCP adapters or reopen CUT-SES-RUN / CUT-RUN-WRK / CUT-RUN-REC beyond proving public behavior
Do not revive monolithic pss-del-run or reopen DEL-RUN-SERVICE / DEL-RUN-ENGINE-PIPELINE deletion leases
testCoverageRequirements: Own proofs under tests/functional/factory_runtime (and existing closely related public Runtime suites such as tests/functional/orchestrators or tests/functional/runtime_api only when they already own the behavior)

First validate whether existing functional proofs already cover inert construction, lifecycle activation, dispatch/observation, and JavaScript/orchestration public surfaces; add only missing external proofs
Do not substitute packaged_root_shape, engine_pipeline_* gate tests, peer-import scanners, or unit-only thin-root proofs for external behavior proof
Do not invent a new peer/root/wire Factory Runtime test subsystem
acceptanceCriteria: External functional proof that Factory Runtime constructs inertly through root.BuildProcess and activates control/observation/dispatch-plan (and existing public JS/orchestration surfaces) after lifecycle (behavioral)

No functional-suite or production peer import of deleted factory_runtime transitional packages (service/, engine/, runtime/, scheduler/, state/, subsystems/, testkit/, exhaustiontests/, …) or factory_runtime/internal from outside the Runtime owner
Packaged Factory Runtime root remains wire/, internal/, transports/ plus thin root contracts (testdata/ may remain as committed unexpected move debt only)
Typecheck, lint, and required CI are terminal green; PR merged before Factory completion
outOfScope: New pkg/root or pkg/wire Factory Runtime composition helpers created only to make tests compile
Package fold/delete under pkg/services/factory_runtime/** (including testdata/ burn-down)
CUT-RUN-REC implementation (separate packet in this wave)
Reopening monolithic DEL-RUN or already-terminal DEL-RUN SERVICE/ENGINE leases
antiPatterns: Treating DEL-RUN SERVICE/ENGINE merge alone as FUN-runtime complete without public-process proof
Building a root/wire 'RuntimeRootFromEdges' subsystem because tests asked for public composition
Treating packaged_root_shape or engine_pipeline_* unit gates as sufficient FUN proof without external lifecycle behavior
Peer-importing factory_runtime/internal or deleted transitional public Runtime packages from functional suites
Inventing protocol adapters or reopening accepted CLI UX under a FUN lease
Folding/deleting testdata/ or other residual dirs under a FUN lease
Touching live Providers HTTP/CLI adapters, WRK/REC/SET/WORK/DEF CLN-DEL lanes, or PSS-I0* under a FUN lease
currentProgress: DEL-RUN-ENGINE-PIPELINE is Factory-terminal (work-task-453 / PR #1637 merged 6e48c875f; idea/plan/task/review complete).

Live pkg/services/factory_runtime public directories are wire/, internal/, transports/, plus residual unexpected testdata/; service/ and engine-pipeline public packages are gone; testkit/exhaustiontests internalized.
Existing tests/functional/factory_runtime covers orchestrators/API/JS surfaces; FUN must validate/extend those for public-process inertness + lifecycle, not invent a second suite topology.
CUT-SES-RUN / CUT-RUN-WRK / IMP-RUN-04 are already Factory-terminal; CUT-RUN-REC is admitted in parallel as a separate lease.
changedPathLease: tests/functional/orchestrators/** and tests/functional/runtime_api/** only when extending existing public Runtime proofs already owned there
pkg/services/factory_runtime/** root contract/characterization tests only when required for public-process proof gaps
exclude Factory Runtime HTTP/CLI/MCP adapter invention
exclude CUT-RUN-REC Recordings-edge retargets (owned by pss-cut-run-rec)
exclude Providers HTTP/CLI adapter leases and Workers/Settings/Work/Recordings/Definitions residual CLN/DEL leases
payload.requestedOutcome: Prove Factory Runtime as a packaged service through public process composition only: root.BuildProcess, public Runtime protocol/root contracts, and edges.Edges effect replacement. Validate and, only where needed, extend focused functional proofs under tests/functional/factory_runtime (reusing existing related public Runtime suites only when they already own the behavior) so Runtime construction remains inert until runtime lifecycle starts, then exercise public control/observation/dispatch-plan and existing JS/orchestration surfaces without importing factory_runtime/internal or deleted transitional public Runtime packages from outside the owner and without inventing pkg/root or pkg/wire test-only composition helpers. Confirm no production peer reaches Runtime through deleted transitional packages. Do not fold or delete packages (including residual testdata/). Do not invent Runtime protocol adapters or reopen accepted Schema-Driven/Clean CLI UX. Do not open PSS-I0* shared integrators. Do not implement CUT-RUN-REC under this lease. Delivery contract: loop implementation and review until required CI is terminal green, every blocking PR conversation comment is addressed, merge conflicts and shared-file churn are reconciled, the PR is merged, and only then complete Factory work.

payload.title: CUT-RUN-REC: Factory Runtime consumes Recordings root only
payload.ask: After Runtime CLN-RUN-FOLD-SERVICE/ENGINE and DEL-RUN SERVICE+ENGINE are Factory-terminal, cut Factory Runtime's Recordings consumer edge so Runtime reaches Recordings only through the Recordings service root contract—no Recordings implementation packages, transitional public dirs, or loose helper surfaces—and prove the boundary with focused Runtime/Recordings tests.
systemShapeRequirements: Lease only Factory Runtime call sites that still reach Recordings through non-root paths or loose Recordings surfaces; retarget them to the Recordings service root contract (and root-owned ledger/replay/event shapes)
Do not fold or delete factory_runtime or recordings packages in this packet
Do not edit root pkg/wire construction except a narrow Runtime→Recordings import retarget if unavoidable
Do not reopen CUT-REC-RUN (already terminal Recordings→Runtime edge) or implement FUN-runtime under this lease
Do not invent Recordings or Runtime HTTP/CLI/MCP adapters
testCoverageRequirements: Add or extend focused Runtime/Recordings boundary tests near the cut (prefer owner-local factory_runtime tests or existing recordings/runtime boundary suites)
Prove Runtime constructs ledger/replay/hosting Recordings requests only through the Recordings root contract
Do not treat FUN-runtime public-process suites as a substitute for this consumer-edge proof
Reuse existing tests when they already cover the boundary; add only missing proofs
acceptanceCriteria: Factory Runtime production code imports Recordings only through the Recordings service root contract (behavioral compile/import proof)
No new Runtime imports of Recordings implementation packages (internal/, service/, or other transitional public Recordings dirs)
Focused tests prove ledger/replay/hosting Recordings construction through the Recordings root boundary (behavioral)
Observable Runtime hosting/replay/execution behavior that depends on Recordings remains preserved
Typecheck, lint, and required CI are terminal green; PR merged before Factory completion
outOfScope: FUN-runtime public-process proof suite (separate packet in this wave)
CUT-REC-RUN reopen or Recordings→Runtime edge rewrites beyond preserving the already-cut direction
IMP-WRK-07 / Providers adapters / DEF residual CLN-DEL
Deleting factory_runtime/testdata or other residual Runtime dirs
antiPatterns: Starting this cut while claiming Runtime fold/DEL leases are still live (they are terminal—do not re-hold)
Folding Recordings or Runtime packages under a CUT lease
Deep-importing recordings/internal or transitional Recordings packages from Runtime production code
Implementing FUN-runtime functional suites under the CUT lease
Editing Automations/Workers/Sessions ownership or inventing protocol adapters
currentProgress: CLN-RUN-FOLD-SERVICE/ENGINE and DEL-RUN-SERVICE/ENGINE are Factory-terminal; factory_runtime implementation leases for folds/deletes are clear.
CUT-REC-RUN (Recordings→Runtime) is already Factory-terminal; this packet is the reverse Runtime→Recordings consumer edge held until ENGINE DEL.

exclude pkg/services/recordings fold/delete / CONTRACT residual implementation

exclude pkg/wire except narrow Runtime→Recordings import retarget if required

payload.requestedOutcome: After Runtime CLN folds and DEL-RUN SERVICE+ENGINE are Factory-complete, lease only Factory Runtime call sites that still reach Recordings through non-root paths or loose Recordings surfaces. Retarget those imports/call sites to the Recordings service root contract so Runtime no longer depends on Recordings implementation packages. Preserve Runtime hosting/replay/execution behavior that depends on Recordings ledgers and hooks. Do not fold or delete factory_runtime or recordings packages; do not edit root pkg/wire beyond a narrow import retarget if required; do not open shared integrators; do not implement FUN-runtime under this lease; do not reopen CUT-REC-RUN. Prove with focused Runtime/Recordings boundary tests that Runtime constructs Recordings requests only through the Recordings root.
